notes: The input is the bytes of one family.yaml.
params.registry is a registry in this repository, as a path from the repository root. params.directory is the directory of the input under families/ in that registry.
family_file.registries.json holds each file of each such registry.
params.files holds every other file a vector adds to the registry, by path from the registry root. A file there replaces the registry's own file at that path.

A family file is validated against the whole registry. To replay a vector: copy the registry, write params.files, write the input to families/<directory>/family.yaml, load the registry and read the report of <directory>.
result is accepted when the report holds no issue of severity error. issues holds every issue in order. value is the parsed family, with every default filled in.
context.host is the host: the aliases it serves, and the paths that are symbolic links with the path each one resolves to.

input.text:
name: scrum-lead
kind: autonomous
description: Refines, points and splits board tickets, dispatches workers, emails the standup.

model: { router: agent-router, budget_usd_per_day: 10 }

files:
  - { path: /srv/agents/code, mode: ro }
  - { path: /srv/agents/vault/house, mode: ro }
  # The lead's own memory between wakes: dispatch ledger, standup timestamp.
  - { path: /srv/agents/vault/house/scrum, mode: rw }

tools:
  # Named tools, not `all`: an autonomous family may not say `all` (§3.4.5).
  board-lead:
    - survey_board
    - get_ticket
    - append_dev_notes
    - set_points
    - mark_refined
    - label_epic
    - mark_blocked
    - file_child_ticket
    - comment_on_ticket
    - file_ticket
  mail: [send_standup_email]

verbs:
  embed: {}
  ha_call:
    allow:
      - { domain: notify, service: mobile_app_example_phone }
  enqueue:
    targets:
      - agent-control-worker
      - finance-worker
      - home-assistant-worker
      - networking-worker
  job_status: {} # reads back the jobs this family enqueued (§3.5.4)

delegates: []

egress: []

shell: false
sandbox_tools: [read, grep, find, ls, write, edit] # the ledger write lane
sandbox: { cpus: 2, memory: 4g }

skills: []

triggers:
  - cron: "@hourly"

# One wake at a time. A second firing queues (§3.14).
max_running_turns: 1

# Most hourly firings find nothing changed. Code checks that first (§3.15).
quiet:
  board: board-lead
  daily: { call: mail__send_standup_email, hour: 16, zone: America/Phoenix, weekdays_only: true }
  floor_hours: 24

# Every dispatch is one phone tap, as today.
approval: [enqueue]

value.name: scrum-lead

issues.msg: 'no-such-alias' is not an alias LiteLLM serves
'/etc/shadow' is under no allowed root; the roots are /srv/agents/vault, /srv/agents/code, /srv/agents/state/index, /srv/agents/work/projects, /srv/agents/work/platform, /srv/agents/work/code-sandbox
'/srv/agents/work/platform/agent-control' is under the platform fence; only agent-control may mount the platform root or hold the 'release' verb
'/srv/agents/sessions/linked-store' is the session store; the runtime mounts it, and a family file never declares it
